primary_metric: mean average precision, equal-weighted over final unseen mechanisms mnar_own_feature, mnar_reversed_sign, block_mcar_2_8, block_mcar_8_14; first average within seed, then across seeds 9401, 9403, 9407
decision_rule: Candidate is a supported pilot only if mean paired primary-metric delta versus the single strongest matched control is >=0.005, every-seed average delta is positive, and the candidate's mean clean AP is no more than 0.01 below that control; otherwise no_gain or inconclusive per parent review. mcar_0.2 is reported separately and excluded from primary shift metric.
strongest_control_choice_rule: Choose one control globally by highest pooled validation AP averaged equally over the three non-clean shared validation cases (mcar_0.2, mcar_0.4, mar_anchor_x0) and three seeds, among augmented_native_nan, all_masks, no_masks, single_conditional_mean, unconditional_mean, and no_augmentation. Freeze that single control before phase two. Also report native_nan and every ablation.

selected_parameters.conditional_imputation: pairwise observed-pair mean/covariance from training inputs only, covariance shrunk 10% toward its diagonal to ensure positive definiteness; ridge 1e-3 on observed covariance for Gaussian conditioning; anchors 0 and 1 remain observed
selected_parameters.augmentation_views: base already-MCAR-masked training input plus one additional MCAR(Uniform[0,.4] per-row), one anchor-MAR, and one own-value MNAR overlay; each overlay masks only currently observed non-anchor entries
selected_parameters.gate_split: stratified 80/20 internal split of available already-masked training rows, random_state seed+500; gate classifier uses 80%; feature mask permutation importance measured on 20% split under base+MCAR+anchor-MAR+own-value overlays
selected_parameters.gate_rule: retain non-anchor feature mask j iff each of four internal calibration-regime log-loss permutation increments >0, mean increment >=0.0001, and population coefficient of variation <=1.0; otherwise drop; anchors always have no mask channel
selected_parameters.random_gate: randomly choose the same number of non-anchor mask channels as stable gate using seed+800
